9. The Respondent Authority is directed to complete the transfer formalities in
respect of Plot No. 2, Sector Ecotech-IV, Greater Noida in favour of the
Revisionist without insisting upon payment of the construction/functional delay
and time-extension charges set aside by this order. The Respondent Authority
shall undertake a fresh reconciliation of the account, give due credit for the
amount of ₹3,13,90,201/- lying towards excess premium, to the extent
applicable, and communicate to the Revisionist, by a reasoned statement of
account, any lawful post-acquisition dues, if remaining. The revision petition is
accordingly disposed of in the above terms.

Letter No. 4495/77-4-26/102 Appeal/25 Dated:as above
1. Chief Executive Officer, GNIDA
2. M/s Ghaziabad Developers & Builders
3. Director I.T. Invest U.P. – to upload the order on the department’s website.
4. Guard file

By Order
(Nirmesh Kumar Shukla)
Joint Secretary
